Name: Rune of Ignition
Description: Erupts a pool of sacred fire that engulfs enemies in blazing torment.

Name: Rune of Chronos
Description: Distorts temporal flow in an area, slowing enemy movements and projectiles by 60%.

Name: Rune of Shockwave
Description: Detonates a concussive burst that flings all encroaching monsters away.

Name: Rune of Consecration
Description: Hallows the ground into a sanctuary that wards off darkness and cleanses corruption.
